title: 第十五章 师太你还是从了吧第十六章 融九阴悟九阳演仙法
content_zh:
几位弟子的反应，并不出乎张真人的意料。
他抬手压了压，等一众弟子坐下，这才缓缓开口：“想当年，郭靖郭大侠和黄蓉黄帮主，守襄阳几十年，最终城破，为了留下传承，就特意打造了倚天剑和屠龙刀。”
老张将过往历史简单讲述了一遍。
郭靖夫妻的事情。
倚天剑和屠龙刀的来历。
还有峨眉派的传承，以及灭绝师太守护的秘密。
“武林至尊，宝刀屠龙，号令天下，莫敢不从，倚天不出，谁与争锋。传了几十年的口号，原来是这个意思。”宋远桥听后，神色复杂，“倚天剑藏功法，屠龙刀内有兵书。”
“所以啊师尊，您老就去了峨眉，威胁了灭绝师太？”俞莲舟古怪地询问。
“威胁？”殷梨亭急了，“师尊绝不会做出这等事情来，肯定是、肯定是……”
他想不出个所以然来。
毕竟功法已经摆在了桌子上。
老张狠狠瞪了俞莲舟一眼，然后看向了殷梨亭，神色复杂，又缓缓道：“灭绝师太毕竟是晚辈，为师怎会威胁。只是，为师转了一圈后，听说了一件事，特意上了峨眉，找到灭绝师太，单刀直入，言说倚天剑内情，告知她为师可以打碎长剑，将里面的功法取出。条件是，摘录一份。”
“不对！”宋远桥立即摇头，“师尊，灭绝师太耿直，性子火爆，您老上山后这番言语，就是当面威胁，她岂能答应。更何况，这关乎峨眉传承，还有脸面。”
“大师兄言之有理。”张松溪深以为然。
林凡只是笑笑不说话，低头狂炫。
刚才药浴，收获颇大，可也是真的饿了。
正好现在填填肚子。
老张不语，只是看着殷梨亭。
殷梨亭慌了：“师尊，是不是有其它原因？”
莫名的感觉头皮发痒，好似多了一顶帽子。

宋远桥几人也看出了苗头，无不挑眉，全都看向了张三丰。
“梨亭，答应为师，无论发生什么，你都要冷静。”老张终于开口，看着这个六弟子，有些心疼。
殷梨亭性子质朴，重情重义。
这是好品质。
却也是缺点。
“师尊，你不要吓弟子，是不是、是不是晓芙出事了？”殷梨亭嘴里发干，神色接连变化，说到最后都带着几分哭腔。
林凡忽然站起身，将众人的目光吸引了过来，他看着殷梨亭十分认真道：“六师兄，对你而言，师尊重不重要？”
“当然重要。”殷梨亭毫不迟疑道，“师尊的养育之恩，教导之情，百世不忘。”
“比纪晓芙重要吗？”林凡再问。
“这个、这个、这个能比较吗？”殷梨亭呆了，不禁结巴。
“你就说，谁重要？”林凡根本不给对方任何辩驳的余地。
“当然是师尊重要。”
“这就对了，师尊已经高寿九十九，翻过年就是百岁长寿仙人。师尊都这么大年纪了，我们作为弟子的，能让师尊伤心？能让师尊难过？能让师尊白发人送黑发人？我们身为弟子，要让师尊安享晚年，享受天伦之乐，长寿百……”
content_en:
The reactions of several disciples were not beyond Master Zhang’s expectations.
He raised his hand to suppress it, and waited for all the disciples to sit down before speaking slowly: "I think back then, Guo Jing, Guo Daxia, and Huang Ronghuang, the gang leader, guarded Xiangyang for decades, and finally the city was destroyed. In order to leave a legacy, they specially created the Yitian Sword and the Dragon Slaying Sword."
Lao Zhang briefly recounted the past history.
The matter of Guo Jing and his wife.
The origins of the Yitian Sword and the Dragon-Slaying Sword.
There is also the inheritance of the Emei Sect and the secrets guarded by Master Miejie.
"The supreme king of martial arts, slaying dragons with precious swords, commands the world. No one dares to disobey, and if he relies on the sky, no one can compete with him. This is the slogan that has been passed down for decades. It turns out that this is what it means." After hearing this, Song Yuanqiao had a complicated look on his face, "The sword of heaven hides the skills, and the dragon-slaying sword contains the book of war."
"So, Master, you always went to Emei and threatened Master Jiejie?" Yu Lianzhou asked strangely.
"Threat?" Yin Liting was anxious, "Master will never do such a thing, it must be, it must be..."
He couldn't think of a reason.
After all, the skills are already on the table.
Lao Zhang glared at Yu Lianzhou fiercely, then looked at Yin Liting, with a complicated look on his face, and said slowly: "Master Jue is a junior after all, how can I threaten my master? However, after I walked around for a while, I heard about something, so I went to Emei specially, found Master Jue, went straight in, told her the inside story of Yitian Sword, and told her that I can break the long sword and take out the skills inside. The condition is that I make an excerpt."
"No!" Song Yuanqiao immediately shook his head, "Master, Master Miejie is too upright and hot-tempered. What you said after you came up the mountain was a threat to your face. How could she agree? What's more, this is about Emei's inheritance and face."
"Elder brother's words make sense." Zhang Songxi believed deeply.
Lin Fan just smiled and said nothing, lowering his head to show off.
The medicinal bath just now was very fruitful, but I was really hungry.
Just in time to fill my stomach.
Lao Zhang said nothing and just looked at Yin Liting.
Yin Liting panicked: "Master, is there any other reason?"
My scalp feels itchy inexplicably, as if there is an extra hat.
Song Yuanqiao and others also saw the signs, they all raised their eyebrows and looked at Zhang Sanfeng.
"Li Ting, I promise to be my master. No matter what happens, you must stay calm." Lao Zhang finally spoke, looking at the sixth disciple with some distress.
Yin Liting has a simple temperament and values ​​love and justice.
This is good quality.
But it is also a shortcoming.
"Master, don't scare this disciple. Is something happened to Xiaofu?" Yin Liting's mouth went dry, his expression changed one after another, and he was crying at the end.
Lin Fan suddenly stood up and attracted everyone's attention. He looked at Yin Liting and said seriously: "Sixth Senior Brother, is master respect not important to you?"
"Of course it is important." Yin Liting said without hesitation, "Master's nurturing grace and teachings will never be forgotten."
"Is it more important than Ji Xiaofu?" Lin Fan asked again.
"Can this, this, and this compare?" Yin Liting was stunned and couldn't help but stutter.
"Just tell me, who's important?" Lin Fan didn't give the other party any room to argue.
"Of course Master respects it."
"That's right. Master has lived to be ninety-nine years old. If you turn over the new year, you will be a hundred-year-old longevity immortal. Master is already so old. As disciples, can we make Master sad? Can we make Master sad? Can we make Master send a white-haired person to a black-haired person? As disciples, we must let the Master enjoy his old age in peace, enjoy family happiness, and live a long life..."
